title: SURGEON VICE ADMIRAL MANISH HONWAD, VSM ASSUMED THE APPOINTMENT OF DIRECTOR & COMMANDANT OF THE ARMED FORCES MEDICAL COLLEGE, PUNE
body_text:
Pune, 1 September 2026
Surgeon Vice Admiral Manish Honwad, VSM assumed the appointment of Director and Commandant of the Armed Forces Medical College, Pune today morning. Having completed his MBBS from Armed Forces Medical College in 1989, he went on to do his MD in Anesthesiology and Critical Care Medicine from Armed Forces Medical College in 1998. He is a WHO Fellow in Neuro-Anesthesiology from National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS), Bangalore. The Flag Officer is also an alumnus of the Indian Institute of Public Administration, New Delhi where he was awarded an M.Phil in Public Administration.
In an exemplary career spanning over 37 years, The Flag Officer has held prestigious academic, clinical, and administrative appointments including Additional Director General Medical Services (Navy) at the Naval HQ, Commanding Officer, INHS Sanjivani and Commanding Officer, INHS Asvini before assuming the appointment of Director and Commandant AFMC.
The Flag Officer is a Certified Healthcare Simulation Educator from Society for Simulation in Healthcare (SSIH), USA and International speaker on Healthcare Simulation at various National and International Conferences.
In recognition for his dedication to patient care and service, the Flag Officer has been conferred with ‘Vishisht Seva Medal’ in 2025. He has also been awarded the Chief of Naval Staff Commendation twice in 2006, 2013 and FOC-in-C (South) Commendation in 2007 and FOC-in-C (West) Commendation in 2011.
On behalf of all ranks of Armed Forces Medical Services, DGAFMS conveys best wishes to the Flag Officer for a successful tenure as Director & Commandant of the Armed Forces Medical College, Pune.

PIB Pune | Ankush Chavan/Darshana Rane

enrichment.summary: Surgeon Vice Admiral Manish Honwad, VSM, assumed charge as Director and Commandant of the Armed Forces Medical College (AFMC), Pune on 1 September 2026. He is an AFMC alumnus with an MD in Anaesthesiology and Critical Care Medicine, a WHO Fellowship from NIMHANS, and prior appointments including Additional Director General Medical Services (Navy) and Commanding Officer of INHS Sanjivani and INHS Asvini. He was conferred the Vishisht Seva Medal in 2025 along with several other commendations during his 37-year career.
enrichment.context: This release is a routine appointment announcement concerning a senior officer of the Armed Forces Medical Services taking charge of AFMC Pune, a premier institution that trains medical officers for the Indian Armed Forces and also admits civilian students. Such appointments are administrative in nature and are announced periodically by PIB as part of routine defence services communication, with no policy, scheme, or institutional change involved.
